descriptions.accommodations_availability: Check detailed product availability, pricing, and charges for a single accommodation. Required: accommodation (property ID), booker, checkin, checkout, guests. Optional: currency, extras (for extended info like photos, facilities), payment. Returns pricing breakdown and product details.
descriptions.accommodations_bulk-availability: Check availability and pricing for multiple accommodations in a single request. Required: accommodations (array of property IDs), booker, checkin, checkout, guests. Optional: currency, extras, filters. Returns array of availability results per property.
descriptions.accommodations_chains: List accommodation chains (hotel groups) and their associated brands. Call with empty body for the full list. Returns chain IDs and brand names usable as filters in search and detail endpoints.
descriptions.accommodations_constants: Retrieve standardized reference codes for accommodation types, facilities, room types, bed types, themes, and charges. Optional: constants (specific types to retrieve), languages. Returns canonical identifiers used across the API.
descriptions.accommodations_details: Get detailed property information matching search criteria. At least one location filter required: accommodations, airport, city, country, or region. Optional: extras for extended info (photos, facilities, rooms). Returns property details including name, address, amenities.
descriptions.accommodations_details-changes: Track accommodations that opened, closed, or had content updates since a timestamp. Required: last_change (ISO timestamp). Optional: filters (country, city). Use the 'next' timestamp from response for incremental updates. Returns up to 5000 changed property IDs per request.
descriptions.accommodations_reviews: Retrieve traveller reviews for specified accommodations. Required: accommodations (array of property IDs). Optional: languages, last_change, page, rows (reviews per property), reviewer, sort. Returns review text, scores, and reviewer metadata.
descriptions.accommodations_search: Search for accommodations by location, dates, and filters. Returns the cheapest available product per property by default. Required: booker, checkin, checkout, guests. Optional: city, country, region, airport, coordinates, accommodation_facilities, cancellation_type, and 20+ other filters. Location-filtered results are sorted by popularity instead of price.
descriptions.cars_depots-reviews-scores: Get review score breakdown for car rental depots, including overall score and review count. Optional: maximum_results (default 100), page. Returns per-depot score distribution.
descriptions.cars_suppliers: List car rental suppliers. Optional: suppliers (array of IDs for specific lookups), maximum_results, page. Returns supplier details. Omit supplier IDs to get the full list.
descriptions.common_locations-countries: List country codes and names in selected languages. Optional: country, region, or other location filters to narrow results. Paginated. Returns ISO2 country codes used as input/output across other endpoints.
descriptions.common_locations-districts: List district codes with translations in selected languages. Filter by city (e.g., city=-2140479 for Amsterdam). Paginated. Returns district IDs used as input/output across other endpoints.
descriptions.common_locations-landmarks: List geographical landmark codes and names in selected languages. Filter by city or other location ID. Paginated. Returns landmark codes used as input/output across other endpoints.
descriptions.common_payments-cards: List supported payment card types and their names. Returns card type codes used as input/output in payment-related endpoints.
descriptions.common_payments-currencies: List currency codes and names in selected languages. Optional: languages. Returns currency codes used as input/output across other endpoints.
descriptions.messages_fetch-latest: Retrieve up to 100 of the most recent messages in reverse chronological order, including messages from both property and guest. Send an empty POST request to get latest messages. Use for syncing message threads or polling for updates.
descriptions.orders_details-flights: Retrieve detailed information for flight orders by order ID or reservation ID. Returns booking details, cancellation info, commission, pricing, and itinerary segments with IATA airport codes. Results sorted by bookingDate descending.
descriptions.orders_modify: Modify aspects of an accommodation order including credit card details, checkin/checkout dates, and room configurations (guest allocation, guest names, smoking preferences). See the Orders modification guide for supported changes.
descriptions.orders_cancel: Cancel a booking order. Required: order (order ID), reason (cancellation reason code). Optional: request_property_approval. Returns cancellation confirmation and any applicable fees.
